evals.name: utils-behavior-preserving-cleanup
evals.prompt: Clean up src/lib/utils.js without changing behavior. It is used across the app. Keep the refactor reviewable.
evals.expected_output: States the behavior invariant, characterizes current behavior, moves in small steps, preserves or explicitly migrates exports, and keeps refactor separate from behavior change.
assertions: Adds or identifies characterization tests before structural change
Preserves or explicitly migrates the public exports
Does not change behavior such as date/currency output or fallbacks
